title: David Jeremiah
description: Dr. David Jeremiah shares the practical messages behind Christianity and helps people to discover their own turning points in their relationship with God.

title: The UnXplained
description:
S02 E12 — The Power of Gold
As one of the most valuable and coveted precious metals on the planet, gold's power over mankind harkens back thousands of years.

title: The UnXplained
description:
S07 E12 — Mysterious Urban Legends
From the eerie reports of spontaneous human combustion and the hunt for the Highgate Vampire, to the unsettling boogeymen known as the Men in Black appearing after UFO sightings, could these legends be more than just stories?

title: The UnXplained
description:
S04 E09 — Superhuman Feats
Whether surviving freezing temperatures, diving unfathomable depths in one breath, or lifting weighty objects, superhuman feats never cease to amaze; pulling them off could be a matter of training, willpower, genetics, or something more mysterious.

title: The UnXplained
description:
S01 E09 — The Oak Island Curse
For more than 200 years, treasure hunters have been coming to Oak Island in search of a treasure that has so far eluded them all, and has even cost six men their lives, could it be, as legend suggests, the treasure is protected by a deadly curse.

title: The UnXplained
description:
S07 E07 — Tales From Antarctica
Isolated along the southernmost part of the planet, Antarctica is best known as the frozen continent.

title: The UnXplained
description:
S04 E17 — America's Lost Treasures
Whether legends of vast, lost treasures hidden throughout the U.S. are real or tall tales.

title: The UnXplained
description:
S07 E14 — Strange Tales From the American Frontier
Bizarre, mysterious tales ran rampant and are still being told to this day; are these strange tales of the American frontier simply legend, or was the west far stranger than one could possibly imagine?

title: The UnXplained
description:
S01 E05 — Bizarre Rituals
Ancient practices such as prayer, blood sports, voodoo and exorcism are often thought to be relics of bygone superstition, but there is evidence they have an impact on the physical world.

title: The UnXplained
description:
S06 E03 — Secrets of Ancient Structures
Age-old mysterious ruins stand as silent sentinels from the past, with their true history seemingly erased by time; modern archaeology attempts to unravel the enigma of how and why the ancient structures were built.

title: The UnXplained
description:
S04 E05 — Acts of God
Examining various events that are said to have been directed by the hand of the Almighty, such as the Great Flood, the Plagues of Egypt, Sodom and Gomorrah, and Moses parting the Red Sea.

title: The UnXplained
description:
S04 E20 — The Weird Wild West
The American frontier is full of legends of cowboys, Native Americans and outlaws; but there are also many eerie stories of cursed mountains, monsters and even UFOs.

title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo
description:
S02 E15 — Lost in Battle
From a live WWII bomb discovered decades later, to a Civil War cigar hiding secret orders, to a Viking sword unearthed by a child, these finds reveal how the remnants of war can resurface when least expected.

title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo
description:
S02 E09 — Found Fortunes
From a Fabergé egg found at a humble flea market, to rare baseball cards hidden inside an old piano or even a backyard sapphire worth a king's ransom; these treasures prove that one person's forgotten clutter can become another's discovery.

title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo
description:
S01 E07 — Beastly Revelations
From a mythical monster that turns out to be real, to a deadly prehistoric animal, and a frozen tundra hiding a pandora's box full of lethal pathogens, these startling discoveries shock and terrify the world.

title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo
description:
S01 E01 — Mysterious Structures
A Revolutionary War era ship hides under the streets of Manhattan; a sprawling Roman villa is unearthed in the backyard of an English home; finding an ancient Grecian maze that is long thought to be a myth.

title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo
description:
S02 E14 — Wild Discoveries
A species thought lost forever is spotted again; a dog plays an unexpected role in recovering the World Cup trophy; a puppy from the Ice Age emerges intact after 18,000 years; revealing just how unpredictable the natural world can be.

title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo
description:
S01 E05 — Sacred Discoveries
From ancient religious texts buried in Egypt to cultural relics found at sea, or even a tower of skulls hiding under the earth, these lost artifacts change what is known about certain sacred beliefs.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S01 E04 — Weird Weapons
A million bats with tiny bombs strapped to their chests, inflatable tanks, robot assassins, bazooka Vespas, and war dolphins; these weapons, and others, pushed the boundaries of "possible" in the weirdest ways ever.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S02 E16 — Extraordinary Traditions
From riding massive tree trunks down a treacherous slope, to hosting a barrage of monkeys for an all-you-can-eat buffet, to a food fight of epic proportions; these are the stories of history's most bizarre and extraordinary traditions.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S02 E18 — Odd Dwellings
From calling Veteran's Stadium home, to setting up camp in an airport terminal, to turning an unassuming dumpster into a luxurious abode, each of these dwellings are so beyond odd, that they are truly unbelievable.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S02 E05 — A Thousand Ways to Die
Beards as cause of death; a lawnmower killing a spectator at a football game; discussing some unusual causes of death.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S01 E07 — Unusual Rituals
Human bones as a "miracle cure" for gout; living mummies buried alive; a truly bizarre Victorian way to lose weight -- with tapeworms; from daily rites to once-in-a-lifetime rituals, the stranger side of human nature is revealed in these rituals.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S03 E03 — Shocking Missions
History is full of legendary missions, but some are so bizarre, they sound like fiction; from a covert op involving toilet paper, to a war sparked by a single tree, to a pilot who turned the skies into a candy drop zone.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S03 E01 — Strange Sightings
From stone-throwing jungle apes, to swarms of sinister clowns stalking the suburbs, to skies raining down murderous birds, these are the strange encounters that leave the experts scratching their heads.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S01 E08 — Strange Experiments
Monkey glands for immortality, hypnotized assassins and a brain-linked cyborg couple; investigating some of the strangest experiments on record.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S01 E03 — Astonishing Bodies
From a headless chicken that lives over one year, to an out-of-this-world "celestial body" where it rains molten glass, the team explores the most astonishing bodies through these truly unbelievable stories.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S01 E09 — What Lies Beneath
A look at tales of strange things below Earth's surface, including sea beasts, hidden cities, and tunnels carved by giant sloths.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S02 E02 — Sweet Revenge
Studying stories of revenge, such as the one about a man in Colorado that uses a Killdozer to settle a zoning dispute or another about an emperor who pickles his wife's lover; exploring vengeance seekers who take things too far.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S01 E10 — Surviving the Impossible
Imagining free-falling 30,000 feet without a parachute, or being buried alive and living to tell the tale; these are improbable yet true-life tales of surviving the most extraordinary conditions.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S02 E06 — Bizarre Innovations
A fully functioning car that hovers in midair; clothing made out of calcium; a robot dog that breathes fire; discussing bizarre inventions.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S03 E20 — Most Shocking Dances With Death
What drives someone to gamble with their own life? From a French tailor who leaps off the Eiffel Tower to a man struck by lightning more times than should be humanly possible, these perilous wagers with death are as shocking as they are unbelievable.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S04 E01 — Epic Fails
A miracle cure with a deadly catch; A romantic gesture explodes in a president's face; A simple home repair spirals wildly out of control; Sometimes the biggest disasters begin with the best intentions.

title: Mysteries From Above
description:
S05 E01 — Unexpected Naturally
Head to the Australian outback for a peek at some beehive-shaped and cone-shaped structures; spot a neon green pool of water in Huelva, Spain; odd geometric shapes near Latvia's Gulf of Riga and a forest anomaly in Hawaii.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S03 E06 — Outlandish Ideas
From a coastal cleanup plan that ends with an earth-shaking surprise, to a fugitive's fiery fix for an unexpected problem, these are the real-life moments when people thought way outside the box.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E04 — Pearl Harbor
Japan escalates their war in China, drawing increasing U.S. sanctions and widespread outrage; driven by resource shortages and military ideology, Japan attacks Pearl Harbor in a move that reshapes the course of World War II.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E05 — The War at Sea
Examine how America's battle to control the seas against the German U-boats in the Atlantic and Japan's navy in the Pacific turns the tide of the war.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E06 — Guadalcanal
After the attack on Pearl Harbor, Japanese forces sweep across Southeast Asia; on Guadalcanal, United States Marines are given the bloody task of stopping their relentless advance.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E07 — Darkness Falls
As Hitler's reach extends beyond Germany and darkness descends on Europe, his hateful rhetoric leads to anti-Jewish persecution and ultimately, genocide.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E08 — Operation Torch
The first joint U.S.-British offensive of the war, thousands of inexperienced U.S. troops and their untested leader Eisenhower, face off against the hardened German Afrika Korps and the infamous Field Marshal Erwin Rommel.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E09 — Secrets and Lies
Behind the fierce frontline clashes of WWII, a hidden battle rages - one of espionage, deception, and codebreaking; in rural England, a group of brilliant academics work to crack Germany's unbreakable Enigma Code and change the course of the war.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E10 — Stalingrad
In Operation Blue, the German Army fights to take Soviet oil fields and the city of Stalingrad, becoming one of the deadliest battles ever fought and a major turning point on the Eastern Front.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E11 — Italy
The Allies hope to quickly penetrate the Nazi Reich via Italy but instead endure a months-long slog with devastating results.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E12 — Battle for the Skies
Allied air forces engage in a fierce and costly battle with the German Luftwaffe over the skies of Europe.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E13 — Overlord
The Allies undertake Operation Overlord, a complicated and massive military invasion, to liberate Occupied France and open a true second front in Western Europe.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E14 — Long Road to Tokyo
The Allies and Japan clash in the jungles and plains of Asia, the "forgotten theater" of World War II, as America struggles to bring the fight to Tokyo's door.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E15 — Home Front
As the tide begins to turn against the Axis powers, the leaders of Germany and Japan deploy opposite strategies on their home fronts.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E16 — Resistance
Resistance to Nazi occupation and oppression is a constant throughout the war, with results both triumphant and devastating.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E17 — No Surrender
The Pacific campaign reaches a brutal and bloody fever pitch from 1944 to 1945.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E18 — Last Days of the Reich
The war in Europe reaches a climax as Allied armies advance towards Berlin and Hitler orders his people to fight to the last man.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E19 — Endgame
The most terrible weapon ever created will change the course of the war in the Pacific.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E20 — Fall Out
The end of the second world war and the dawn of the nuclear age see its two great victors go from allies to adversaries.

S01 E01 — The Beginning
In September 1939, Germany invades Poland, setting the stage for the most destructive war in history.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E02 — Blitz
After toppling the Netherlands and Belgium, Nazi Germany pushes further west; the Allies scramble to support France as Churchill is forced to defend Britain from the skies and FDR rushes to mobilize wartime production.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E03 — Barbarossa
Examine the story of Operation Barbarossa, Hitler's surprise invasion of the Soviet Union in 1941, the largest and costliest land offensive in human history.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks

title: American Pickers
description:
S03 E10 — The Possum Trot
Bill's main street hardware store; the guys are invited to the Possum Trot, a down-home country auction; Ed's Georgia property features a missile on the lawn and building after building of awesome stuff.

title: American Pickers
description:
S26 E12 — Junkyard Jamboree
In Alabama, Robbie and Jersey go hog wild for Edd's classic car collection and bad-to-the-bone boneyard; Mike has a once-in-a-lifetime brush with country music stardom as he combs through the belongings of Hank Williams Jr.

title: American Pickers
description:
S02 E08 — One Pony Town
Lifelong picker and yard-sale aficionado Lester is known by his neighbors as the spooky collector; the guys visit a hard-core Illinois collector who says he wants to downsize; the guys pay a return visit to their picking mamma, Judy.

title: American Pickers
description:
S08 E08 — Hometown Pickin'
The guys find themselves waist deep in Kenny's ragtag collection; a man's stockpile is so large that he keeps it in an old school; a pair of muskets that could be centuries old; the guys pick in Mike's hometown.

title: American Pickers
description:
S07 E08 — Duke of Oil
Mike falls for a one-of-a-kind vintage motorcycle sign; a man keeps his treasures in a creepy cabin in the woods; Danielle's unique company car drives her crazy.

title: American Pickers
description:
S03 E03 — What's in the Box?
A New York collector has filled a train station with vintage cars; the guys stop at a New Hampshire home with an interesting weathervane on the roof; auctioneer Paul's property is packed with treasures his father rescued from the trash.

title: American Pickers
description:
S07 E04 — Guys and Dollhouses
A vintage theater marquee; rare opera house relics; Mike gets into a heated negotiation over a Victorian doll house.
